title: Crispy Bratwurst Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional German bratwurst, these crispy empanadas are filled with juicy sausage and served as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Bratwurst sausage
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade sausage for this recipe

ingredients.name: Uruguayan empanada dough
ingredients.notes: You can also use homemade dough or store-bought empanada wrappers

ingredients.name: Aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: Use a blend of paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder for added flavor

ingredients.name: Crispy empanada crust
ingredients.notes: Use panko breadcrumbs for a light and crispy crust

ingredients.name: Fat
ingredients.notes: Use vegetable oil or lard for frying the empanadas

ingredients.name: Score
ingredients.notes: Use a pastry brush to apply the score (a mixture of egg and water) to the empanada dough

instructions: Prepare the empanada dough according to the package instructions.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a few slices of bratwurst sausage in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges with the score (egg and water mixture).
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the remaining score mixture.
Dip the tops of the empanadas in the crispy empanada crust mixture.
Fry the empanadas in hot oil (about 1-2 inches deep) at 375°F (190°C) for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the empanadas on paper towels and serve hot.
